_readme: Data for tools/build_map.py. 'theorems': short theorem name -> kind (outright = paper step proved outright, conditional = paper step proved from named hypotheses), preprint page, and what it checks. Unlisted theorems show as supporting lemmas. 'module_areas': module -> band index in 'areas'; modules not listed use the SectionN prefix of their name, else the last band. 'hypotheses': the ledger inputs of Theorem 11.1 and the modules that partly reduce each.
hypotheses: Splitting: trace linearity of the squared partition
Edge length kept by vertex cutoffs is 6a − O(ε)

abs_parity_sum.note: (3.8): rank-one weight (2/π²)sinh(πv)·π²/(4cosh πv) = tanh(πv)/2; summed absolute integrand = tanh(πv)(csch αv − csch πv).

band_resolvent_integral.note: (5.9): ∫_{L/2}^{2L} t/((t−L)²+w²) dt ≤ 2πL/w (narrow w = 1 and wide windows).

beta_integrable.note: Lemma 4.1: the two factors convolve to exactly C C' B(q,q) u^(2q−1) e^(−cu); B(q,q) converges.

bounded_shift_can_change_linear.note: A L^2 shifted by d changes by 2AdL - Ad^2, as in Remark 5.2.

bounded_shift_changes_linear_term.note: Exact polynomial expansion showing a shift B+c changes the linear Weyl term (Remark 5.2).

chart_loss_le_total.note: Trivial: nonnegative total loss bounds each chart's loss; helper for partition summation.

choose_scales.note: Scalar error C eps + D gamma can be made below any delta (helper).

collar_geometric_bound.note: (2/L)·Σ(2w/L)^n·C(1+L+w) ≤ 12C: the (7.46) series is O(1) in HS norm.

collar_geometric_bound_sum.note: Termwise form of the (7.46) series bound ≤ 12C.

cone_ball_window.note: Trihedral ball increment bound; the hypothesis already is the conclusion (tautological).

constant_scale_error.note: Unsuppressed per-step error accumulates linearly; paper keeps step count finite and errors O(h^inf).

correction_le_two_t.note: Correction is O(t), so it is o(1/t) in heat expansion; integral identity itself not formalized.

correction_nonneg.note: Oscillatory Laplace correction 2t/(1+t^2)^2 is nonnegative; only algebra, not the integral identity.

cos_time_lipschitz.note: Scalar: cos(tx) is |t|-Lipschitz, the time factor retained in Duhamel.

coth_form.note: (3.9): summing parity traces gives tanh(πv)(coth αv − coth πv) = sinh((π−α)v)/(cosh πv sinh αv); hence c_α in the coth form. (That B_α − B_π is trace class with this trace is not formalized.)

coth_strictAnti.note: Signs: m_{α,+} − m_{π,+} > 0 and m_{α,−} − m_{π,−} < 0 for 0 < α < π.

cs_double.note: Helper: Cauchy–Schwarz for double sums, used to bound trace terms like (7.25).

cubic_intertwining.note: Cubic telescoping intertwining identity; polynomial case of functional-calculus linearity in K.

cumulative_transfer_bound.note: Cumulative comparison bound from split energies; Lipschitz constants, tail and mass bounds are named hypotheses.

cumulative_transfer_telescope.note: Generic scalar helper: additive step errors telescope; paper has no stepwise transfer, serves (7.29) bookkeeping.

denominator_pos.note: Positivity of (1+t^2)^2 in Laplace transform of oscillating density 2x+1+x sin x, like the counterexample.

duhamel_cos_hs.note: Cosine part of (7.24) in spectral coordinates: ‖cos(tA)J−Jcos(tB)‖_HS² ≤ t²‖K‖_HS².

duhamel_discrete_budget_le.note: Uniform slice bound (7.23) gives cumulative n*C budget, discrete analogue of |t|eps(h) in (7.24).

duhamel_discrete_budget_nonneg.note: Discretized helper: nonnegative Duhamel slice bounds sum nonnegatively, serving (7.24).

duhamel_entry.note: Entrywise (7.24) in spectral coordinates: coefficient of e^{itA}J−Je^{itB} bounded by |t||K_ij|.

duhamel_entry_sq.note: Squared entrywise form of (7.24): coefficient² ≤ t²K_ij².

duhamel_hs.note: HS form of Duhamel with time factor: ‖e^{itA}J−Je^{itB}‖_HS² ≤ t²‖K‖_HS² in spectral coordinates.

duhamel_hs_of_inputs.note: Duhamel HS bound t²Ck²(1+L)², taking the Lemma 7.1′ / (7.2) defect bound as hypothesis.

duhamel_sin_hs.note: Sine part of (7.24) in spectral coordinates: ‖sin(tA)J−Jsin(tB)‖_HS² ≤ t²‖K‖_HS².

duplicate_rank_excess.note: Excess of q-fold duplication is (q-1)n; motivates exact squared partition.

duplicate_rank_overcount.note: Duplicated modes overcount by factor q; squared partition avoids duplication in summation.

dyadic_relative_primitive_bound.note: Assuming dyadic majorants (7.42), sum of scalars G_j bounded by 4C/3.

dyadic_sum.note: Exact finite geometric series 1/2^j behind dyadic vertex summation (helper).

dyadic_sum_le_two.note: Finite dyadic sum bounded by 2, so annular sums are uniformly bounded (helper).

edge_heat_limit.note: Edge term of (4.10) from (4.9) by dominated convergence (q_α ∈ L¹ taken as given).

edge_integral_bounds.note: One edge: a−2r ≤ ∫ q² ≤ a when vertex cutoffs act within r of endpoints.

edge_invariant_determined.note: Consistency checks on (1.3): the coefficients of a sharp law are unique (so c in (11.4) is determined), the a² and a factors scale correctly, and the real law implies the integer-level law; applied to the conditional Theorem 11.1.

edge_of_model_compare.note: Model edge law plus o(L) comparison gives edge law (11.3); both inputs are hypotheses.

endpoint_eigen_minus.note: (3.2)→(3.6): the endpoint matrix [[coth x, csch x],[csch x, coth x]] has eigenvalues coth x ± csch x = coth(x/2), tanh(x/2).

endpoint_eigen_plus.note: (3.2)→(3.6): the endpoint matrix [[coth x, csch x],[csch x, coth x]] has eigenvalues coth x ± csch x = coth(x/2), tanh(x/2).

even_pos.note: Signs: m_{α,+} − m_{π,+} > 0 and m_{α,−} − m_{π,−} < 0 for 0 < α < π.

exp_half_le_cosh.note: Helper inequality e^x/2 ≤ cosh x, used to bound the (1.4)/(3.9) integrand.

explicit_barrier_numerator.note: Polynomial certificate: Laplacian numerator of an explicit cusp barrier is negative; PDE part not formalized.

finite_eigenstate_squared_partition.note: Finite-dimensional: squared partition gives localized mass one for a normalized state.

finite_hs_tail_le_total.note: Finite matrices: restricting columns cannot increase squared HS norm.

finite_hs_tail_vanishes.note: Finite-rank array has zero HS tail above its maximal column energy.

finite_local_count_identity.note: Finite-dimensional: counting function equals sum of localized counts at any real L.

finite_local_spectral_mass_nonneg.note: Finite-dimensional: localized trace of a nonnegative multiplier is nonnegative.

finite_mass_weight_bound.note: Finite sum: per-window mass bound M times nonnegative kernel; window bound is a hypothesis.

finite_offband_hs_gap.note: Finite-spectrum off-band mass bounded by defect budget over squared gap, assuming coefficientwise defect dominance; scalar analogue of (5.10).

finite_partition_error.note: Finite sum of localized errors bounded by sum of bounds; local bounds assumed.

finite_phase_cell_error_budget.note: Polynomially many cells with h^(N+M) errors sum to h^N; counts and errors assumed.

finite_relative_inverse_trace.note: Finite spectrum: inverse trace difference equals sum of termwise differences.

finite_schwartz_window_bound.note: Finite version of (11.2): window bounds assumed, summed against absolute kernel weights.

finite_spectral_count_below_bottom.note: Finite spectrum: count vanishes below bottom, fixing the negative-energy normalization.

finite_spectral_trace_squared_partition.note: Finite-dimensional: localized spectral traces sum to the full trace under squared partition.

finite_sylvester_hs_gap.note: Finite diagonal model: gap d gives d^2 times HS mass of J at most HS norm of defect, as in (7.46).

finite_window_count_from_gap.note: Window count bounded via spectral gap and low-band budget; frame bound and gap estimate are explicit hypotheses.

finite_window_mass_budget.note: Scalar step: frame lower bound plus small low-band mass forces half the window count into high-band mass (window counting, Sec. 7.8).

first_riesz_coefficients.note: Algebraic integration of the leading polynomial, giving A/3 and B/2 coefficients only.

first_riesz_coefficients_paper.note: At r = 1 the coefficients of (1.9) are √3a²/(12π) and 3ac.

fixed_time_step_budget.note: Fixed time T=Nh with per-step error εh gives cumulative εT; scalar helper for fixed-time transfer.

fixed_width_budget.note: Width term C*width+eps stays nonnegative at fixed width; only the gamma-to-zero limit removes it.

formula_11_4_of_C4.note: Formula (11.4) with paper's constants from the C4 ledger; analytic inputs assumed.

formula_11_4_of_inputs.note: Formula (11.4) with c = dihedral coefficient at arccos(1/3), from the ledger.

formula_3_13.note: (3.13) from the spectral-shift formula (3.10), taken as a named hypothesis for each momentum k.

frobenius_sq_mul_diagonal_le.note: Matrix form: ‖X diag y‖_F² ≤ ‖X‖_F²B²; HS ideal property used in (7.2) step.

gamma_reflection_imag.note: Gamma step of (3.4): Γ(1/2+iv)Γ(1/2−iv) = π/cosh(πv), so πΓΓ/4 = π²/(4 cosh πv). The double integral (3.5) is not formalized.

gd_zero.note: Helper: antiderivative value at 0 is 1/2; serves ∫ = 1/2.

geom_partial_le_two.note: Helper: geometric partial sums with ratio ≤ 1/2 are ≤ 2; contraction constant 2w/L < 1/2.

geom_partial_le_two_sub.note: Helper: geometric partial sums with ratio ≤ 1/2 are ≤ 2−2r^N; serves the (7.46) series.

gradient_scaling_cancel.note: Scalar: λ⁻¹·C·(λG) = CG, the factor r cancels the cutoff's r⁻¹ Lipschitz norm.

gradient_scaling_div.note: Division form of the gradient-scaling cancellation.

half_le_sinh.note: Helper inequality y/2 ≤ sinh y, used to bound the (1.4)/(3.9) integrand.

hasDerivAt_gd.note: Helper: derivative of antiderivative of sech(πv); serves ∫ sech(πv) = 1/2.

heat_trace_integrable.note: From (4.5) (taken as hypothesis) the trace norm is integrable over u, with ∫ ≤ K c^(−2q) Γ(2q).

hs2_le_of_pointwise.note: Finite-dimensional: |Tf(i)| ≤ w_i‖f‖ for all f gives ‖T‖_HS² ≤ Σw_i².

hs2_mul_diag_le.note: HS of X·diag(y) ≤ HS(X)·sup|y| in spectral coordinates; HS times bounded factor.

hs2_nonneg.note: Helper: squared Hilbert–Schmidt norm in spectral coordinates is nonnegative; serves Lemma 5.1 formalization.

hyperbolic_subtraction.note: sinh subtraction formula used to rewrite the integrand in the second equality of (3.9).

improved_barrier_numerator.note: Numerator bound for beta=3/2, gamma=2 barrier on 4r<=d; PDE part not formalized.

indicator_sum_scaled.note: Finite spectrum: 1_[0,L](T/λ) = 1_[0,λL](T), spectral projector under scaling.

integrableOn_dihedral_right_angle.note: At α=π/2 the (1.4) integrand is integrable on (0,∞).

integrableOn_dihedral_tetra.note: Integrability of (1.4) integrand at the tetrahedral angle arccos(1/3).

integral_rpow_two_beta_sub_two.note: ∫₀¹ s^(2β−2) ds = 1/(2β−1): square of r^(β−1) bound (7.4) is integrable.

integral_rpow_two_mu_sub_one.note: ∫₀¹ s^(2μ−1) ds = 1/(2μ), companion integrability computation for Lemma 7.1′.
